items.example: In my opinion, the town centre needs more cycle lanes.

note.en: Safe in speaking and writing. Do not say 'in my opinion' and 'I think' together.
note.es: Sirve para hablar y escribir. No lo mezcles con «I think» en la misma frase.

items.example: I'd say that working from home suits most people better than commuting.

note.en: A relaxed way to give a view in conversation.
note.es: Forma relajada de dar tu opinión al hablar.

items.example: Personally, I think online lessons are less tiring than evening classes.
I really feel that our flat is too small for three people.
If you ask me, the bus service has got worse since the new timetable.

note.en: Chatty and a little blunt. Avoid it in a formal email.
note.es: Coloquial y algo directo. Evítalo en un email formal.

items.example: As far as I'm concerned, a four-day week would improve everyone's health.

note.en: Firm opinion about your own position, not a fact.
note.es: Expresa tu postura personal con firmeza, no un hecho.

items.example: From my point of view, the museum should stay free for students.
I'm convinced that recycling schemes work best when they are simple.
It strikes me that the proposal ignores the needs of older residents.

note.en: Introduces an impression you have reached after thinking.
note.es: Introduce una impresión a la que has llegado tras reflexionar.

items.example: To my mind, the greatest risk of social media is the loss of attention.

note.es: Algo literario. Es «to my mind», no «in my mind».

items.phrase: I am inclined to believe that …
items.example: I am inclined to believe that the survey results were affected by the wording of the questions.

note.en: Gives an opinion while sounding open to other views.
note.es: Da tu opinión dejando margen a otras posturas.

items.phrase: I'd go so far as to say that …
items.example: I'd go so far as to say that this app has changed how we organise the office.
I think the museum is very interesting.
I don't think the bus is a good idea. It is very slow.

note.en: Say 'I don't think it is', not 'I think it isn't'.
note.es: Se dice «I don't think it is», no «I think it isn't».
